name: PRS 销售坏账与费用看板
description: 销售赠送、坏账、运费、人工费和额外费用业务口径。

config.text: PRS 销售坏账与费用看板

sqlConfig.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name AS label, project_name AS value FROM public.xycyl_dwd_flowerbiz_main WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name <> '' ORDER BY project_name
SELECT DISTINCT customer_name AS label, customer_name AS value FROM public.xycyl_dwd_flowerbiz_main WHERE customer_name IS NOT NULL AND customer_name <> '' ORDER BY customer_name

WITH sale AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(s."销售金额全口径")::numeric,2) AS sale_amt, ROUND(SUM(s."销售成本全口径")::numeric,2) AS sale_cost, ROUND(SUM(s."赠送成本全口径")::numeric,2) AS gift_cost FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_sale_summary s WHERE s."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND s."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND s."客户" = {{customerName}}]]), bad AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(b."坏账成本全口径")::numeric,2) AS bad_cost, ROUND(SUM(b."坏账租金损失全口径")::numeric,2) AS bad_rent FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_baddebt_summary b WHERE b."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND b."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND b."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND b."客户" = {{customerName}}]]), extra AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(e."含税金额合计")::numeric,2) AS extra_amt FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_extra_cost_summary e WHERE e."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND e."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND e."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND e."客户" = {{customerName}}]]) SELECT COALESCE(sale_amt,0) AS "销售金额", COALESCE(sale_cost,0) AS "销售成本", COALESCE(gift_cost,0) AS "赠送成本", COALESCE(bad_cost,0) AS "坏账成本", COALESCE(bad_rent,0) AS "坏账租金损失", COALESCE(extra_amt,0) AS "额外费用" FROM sale, bad, extra

SELECT s."业务月份", ROUND(SUM(s."销售金额全口径")::numeric,2) AS "销售金额", ROUND(SUM(s."销售成本全口径")::numeric,2) AS "销售成本", ROUND(SUM(s."赠送成本全口径")::numeric,2) AS "赠送成本" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_sale_summary s WHERE s."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND s."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND s."客户" = {{customerName}}]] GROUP BY s."业务月份" ORDER BY s."业务月份"

SELECT v."费用类型", SUM(v."金额") AS "金额" FROM (SELECT '运费' AS "费用类型", e."运费合计" AS "金额" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_extra_cost_summary e WHERE e."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND e."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND e."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND e."客户" = {{customerName}}]] UNION ALL SELECT '人工费', e."人工费合计" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_extra_cost_summary e WHERE e."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND e."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND e."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND e."客户" = {{customerName}}]] UNION ALL SELECT '垃圾清理费', e."垃圾清理费合计" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_extra_cost_summary e WHERE e."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND e."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND e."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND e."客户" = {{customerName}}]] UNION ALL SELECT '其他费用', e."其他费用合计" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_extra_cost_summary e WHERE e."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND e."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND e."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND e."客户" = {{customerName}}]]) v GROUP BY v."费用类型" HAVING SUM(v."金额") <> 0 ORDER BY SUM(v."金额") DESC

SELECT b."项目", ROUND(SUM(b."坏账成本全口径")::numeric,2) AS "坏账成本", ROUND(SUM(b."坏账租金损失全口径")::numeric,2) AS "租金损失" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_baddebt_summary b WHERE b."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND b."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND b."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND b."客户" = {{customerName}}]] GROUP BY b."项目" ORDER BY SUM(b."坏账成本全口径") DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT x."业务月份", x."项目", x."客户", SUM(x."销售金额") AS "销售金额", SUM(x."销售成本") AS "销售成本", SUM(x."赠送成本") AS "赠送成本", SUM(x."坏账成本") AS "坏账成本", SUM(x."租金损失") AS "租金损失", SUM(x."额外费用") AS "额外费用" FROM (SELECT s."业务月份", s."项目", s."客户", s."销售金额全口径" AS "销售金额", s."销售成本全口径" AS "销售成本", s."赠送成本全口径" AS "赠送成本", 0::numeric AS "坏账成本", 0::numeric AS "租金损失", 0::numeric AS "额外费用" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_sale_summary s WHERE s."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND s."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND s."客户" = {{customerName}}]] UNION ALL SELECT b."业务月份", b."项目", b."客户", 0,0,0,b."坏账成本全口径",b."坏账租金损失全口径",0 FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_baddebt_summary b WHERE b."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND b."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND b."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND b."客户" = {{customerName}}]] UNION ALL SELECT e."业务月份", e."项目", e."客户", 0,0,0,0,0,e."含税金额合计" FROM public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_extra_cost_summary e WHERE e."业务月份" >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND e."业务月份" <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') [[AND e."项目" = {{projectName}}]] [[AND e."客户" = {{customerName}}]]) x GROUP BY x."业务月份", x."项目", x."客户" ORDER BY x."业务月份" DESC, (SUM(x."销售金额")+SUM(x."坏账成本")+SUM(x."额外费用")) DESC LIMIT 300
